apps.name: AuraLyrics
apps.subtitle: Floating Spotify lyrics for macOS
apps.description: Minimalist, always-on-top lyrics window for Spotify with menu bar controls.
apps.longDescription: AuraLyrics displays real-time synchronized lyrics in a floating window on macOS. It reads playback state from the Spotify desktop app through Spotify's own scripting interface — no API keys or accounts — and looks lyrics up in the LRCLIB community database. Aura mode shows three borderless lines with a halo drawn from the album artwork; the lyrics view spreads the same colour into an ambient background. Native Swift and SwiftUI, no third-party libraries, no telemetry.
apps.brew: brew tap ozcberkay/tap && brew trust ozcberkay/tap && brew install --cask auralyrics
apps.requirements: macOS 14.0 or later; Spotify desktop app
features: Aura mode — three borderless lines with an album-coloured halo
Lyrics view — full song over an ambient album-coloured background
Two-layer cache for instant repeat playback
No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry
